ideas.pitch: An interactive, automated treasure hunt platform designed for online hackathons that deploys dynamic cryptographic puzzles and location-less digital clues.
ideas.title: CryptoQuest: Automated Web3 Treasure Hunt Platform
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the event's specific focus on treasure hunts and quizzes with a fully functioning interactive web app stands out against generic submissions.

ideas.pitch: A real-time competitive logic and DSA puzzle platform featuring automated code evaluation and progressive difficulty unlockable rounds.
ideas.title: LogicLabyrinth: Algorithmic Quiz and Puzzle Arena
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly aligns with the host club's explicit focus on logical reasoning, data structures and algorithms, and competitive problem-solving.

ideas.pitch: A modular puzzle engine that generates multi-layered riddles and ciphers requiring logical reasoning and lateral thinking to solve sequentially.
ideas.title: EnigmaEngine: Dynamic Clue Generation & Decryption Game
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the 'Where Logic Meets Expression' theme by blending strict algorithmic validation with creative, expressive riddle generation.

ideas.pitch: A creator tool that allows hosts to rapidly layout node-based treasure hunts with conditional logic gating hints and progression.
ideas.title: QuestCanvas: Interactive Riddle Creator for Treasure Hunts
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solvers and hosts alike love infrastructure tools; demonstrating a platform that enables the hackathon's core format shows high utility.

ideas.pitch: A fast-paced solo-player trivia and logic relay platform featuring live leaderboards and instant verification checks.
ideas.title: CipherSprint: Timed Logic & Trivia Relay
ideas.why_it_could_win: Matches the online format and 24-48 hour constraint with a polished, highly engaging user experience and real-time state management.
